standards.applies_because: Changing units for domestic use: safety requirements (EU)
Changing units: test methods (stability, strength, barriers)
US mandatory safety standard for baby changing products (CPSC, incorporates ASTM F2388)
US children's product: lead / phthalates limits, third-party testing, tracking labels
Activity parts or toys attached to the table (mechanical and physical properties, small parts)
Migration of heavy metals from paints and coatings a child can mouth
General Product Safety Regulation covers any consumer product placed on the EU market

risks.risk: Tip-over when a child climbs or pulls on the top
risks.mitigation: Wide base, low centre of mass, wall anti-tip strap supplied and required in the manual

risks.risk: Baby rolls off the changing surface
risks.mitigation: Raised barriers on all sides of the changing area (height per EN 12221-1 / ASTM F2388, to be confirmed)

risks.risk: Finger and head entrapment in gaps and hinges
risks.mitigation: Keep gaps < 5 mm or > 12 mm (fingers); no V-shaped openings; soft-close hinges

risks.risk: Small parts and choking (knobs, activity beads)
risks.mitigation: Small-parts cylinder test; captive fasteners; no detachable caps

risks.risk: Coatings with lead or heavy metals
risks.mitigation: EN 71-3 / CPSIA compliant water-based finishes, lab reports per colour

tests.name: Stability / tip-over (loaded and unloaded, drawers open)
tests.method: Tilt and horizontal-force tests per the standard

tests.name: Static load on the changing surface and barriers
tests.method: Apply the specified masses for the specified time, check deformation

tests.name: Durability (fatigue of hinges, drawers, fold mechanism)
Small parts, sharp edges and points
tests.method: Small-parts cylinder, sharp edge / point tester

tests.name: Heavy metals and phthalates in coatings
tests.method: Accredited lab, each colour and material

params.connectivity: none (optional BLE for a night-light app)

prototype.method: CNC-cut birch plywood panels, hand-finished (1:1 prototype)
steps: Cut plywood panels on a CNC router from the CAD outlines
Dry-fit, then glue and screw with the production fasteners
Apply an EN 71-3 compliant water-based finish
Run an in-house tip test: incline and horizontal push at the top edge
Book a pre-test at an accredited nursery-furniture lab
